title: The best tour we have done
text: The Alhambra captures the essence of the rich culture the Moorish period in the history of Granada. Our guide Ferando was brilliant, enthusiastically explaining the historical background and architectural achievements in detail andcthat made our visit an unforgettable experience. We felt a private tour gave us the opportunity to get the most out time there.
author: Christopher_T

title: Amazing tour and experience
text: We loved seeing the Alhambra and Angela was an amazing tour guide. Her knowledge of the history and culture really made the visit  exceptional for us. Our tour group was small with 7 people, which was nice too.
author: soumieaa

title: Unforgettable!
text: This was a must-do in Granada. We were in Madrid for most of our Spain vacation but decided to go to Granada last minute for 2 nights. Veronika, the owner of Alhambra Guide, worked miracles to get newly released tickets as they had sold out long ago. We had a group of 5 with age range from 20 to 50s and everyone loved our tour. Alba, our wonderful guide, grew up in Alhambra and studied tourism at university. She is extremely knowledgeable but also so fun and engaging. She had the best photo spots picked out and shared so many fascinating stories and details. Alba also gave us helpful info abou
author: 714JulieG

title: Excellent tour, well run and very informative.
text:
Well worth the money to have such an enthusiastic guide to take us around this magnificent place. Took a good three hours to fully visit and we were told masses of information about the Alhambra etc.  
need good walking shoes and comfy clothing but nothing too strenuous although visit does involve climbing up and down slopes and steps.  
Limited food and drink opportunities and very controlled on where you can eat, if you need to. Toilet facilities adequate but again limited where they were sited. 
Would highly recommend our lovely Laura.
author: Deb_W

title: Very informative
text: Very knowledgeable guide, she was very personable and explained the history of the Alhambra as well as the art and design in a concise fashion.
